description: This Java interface defines a factory for creating criteria objects used in querying, including methods for logical combinations, field filtering, and predicates like equality, inequality, comparison, and inclusion.

classes.name: CriteriaFactory
classes.description: An interface for building query criteria with methods for logical operations, field filtering, and predicates.

methods.name: any
methods.description: Creates a Criteria that matches any document.

methods.name: and
methods.description: Creates a Criteria representing a logical AND of provided criterias.

methods.name: or
methods.description: Creates a Criteria representing a logical OR of provided criterias.

methods.name: nor
methods.description: Creates a Criteria representing a logical NOR of provided criterias.

methods.name: nor (default method)
methods.description: Creates a Criteria representing a logical NOR of a single criteria.

methods.name: fieldCriteria
methods.description: Creates a Criteria to filter based on a field value using a predicate.

methods.name: existsCriteria
methods.description: Creates a Criteria to check for the existence of a field.

methods.name: eq
methods.description: Creates a predicate to check for equality.

methods.name: ne
methods.description: Creates a predicate to check for inequality.

methods.name: gt
methods.description: Creates a predicate to check for greater than.

methods.name: ge
methods.description: Creates a predicate to check for greater than or equal.

methods.name: lt
methods.description: Creates a predicate to check for less than.

methods.name: le
methods.description: Creates a predicate to check for less than or equal.

methods.name: like
methods.description: Creates a predicate to check for pattern matching.

methods.name: in
methods.description: Creates a predicate to check if a field's value is in a list of values.
